# GitHub Copilot Pipeline Workflow (`Plan -> Build -> Test`)

This directory stores state blueprints generated by `@py-planner` and consumed by `@py-builder` and `@py-tester`.

## Standard Pipeline Invocation Commands

### 1. Planning Phase (`@py-planner`)
Invoke the planner agent in GitHub Copilot chat to generate an architectural blueprint artifact:

```text
@py-planner Design the core and CLI components for extracting a page range from a PDF.
```

`@py-planner` inspects the codebase and writes the resulting blueprint to `.github/state/<feature>.blueprint.md`.

---

### 2. Implementation Phase (`@py-builder`)
Invoke the builder agent to execute the saved blueprint state artifact:

```text
@py-builder Execute the blueprint in .github/state/<feature>.blueprint.md
```

`@py-builder`:
1. Reads `.github/state/<feature>.blueprint.md`.
2. Edits production code and unit test files.
3. Automatically runs `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run mypy core cli`, and `uv run pytest`.
4. Applies self-healing fixes up to 3 retry cycles if checks fail.

---

### 3. Verification Phase (`@py-tester`)
Invoke the QA agent to independently verify the implementation against the blueprint:

```text
@py-tester Verify implementation against .github/state/<feature>.blueprint.md
```

`@py-tester`:
1. Validates synthetic in-memory fixtures in `tests/`.
2. Runs the full test suite with `uv run pytest`.
3. Ensures zero static PDF binaries were committed to disk.
